notes: Focus on visual items inside the loop: the loop must re-run the checker every iteration and must not mark a visual item done while it fails.

evals.prompt: Run the work loop on fixtures/INTENT.md.
evals.expected_output: Every Done item passes with evidence; visual items carry checker output and screenshots.
expectations: done.json evidence for each visual item includes the check-page.mjs summary line and screenshot paths
No visual item is marked pass while check-page.mjs reported a FAIL for that page
When the checker failed, the loop fixed and re-ran it instead of editing done.json or adding --allow without a user ask
The look was not chosen inside the loop; it came from DESIGN.md
A fresh reviewer ran before the handoff
